saw_lines: Snack buyers want the treat without the sugar guilt, and they pick a jar or bar in seconds.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer decides if the snack fits.
Your site lists 100+ team and 170+ products, yet only 5 of 30 ads use a proof number. Print 100+ on the creative and open two ads with a customer review.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site lists 100+ team and 170+ products, yet only 5 of 30 ads use a proof number. New buyers need proof before they trust the first line. Put 100+ on the creative and open two ads with a customer review.

Your median ad runs 136 words and the longest 168, so the offer sits where most readers have left. Buyers who stop early never reach a reason to click. Cut each ad to two lines, then the offer, then the link.
Your homepage promotes a bundle, yet 0 of 23 ads mention it or any other offer. A first time buyer sees no reason to act today. Lead three new ads with the bundle in line one and link them to it.
13 different openings run across 23 copy ads, so no single hook gets built out. Start from the 11 ads running 60+ days, pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Proof led creative on the top opener, with the bundle in line two
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
